text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to start the new year with a
shrine visit.
There, I plan to pray for
rapid growth and success
during Wonder
Acute's senior year.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I don't think I can. I'd love to go,
truly,
but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's just too cold today... These old
bones are
having trouble moving. What's
more, I had a
runny nose all morning...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I hope you can understand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like the cold weather is proving
itself an
insurmountable foe. I guess I'll
have to give up on
that shrine visit.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I've thought of something that just
might
work. If I can't make it to the
shrine...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Then maybe the gods can meet me here.

Trainer, you can stand in for them.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think I have just the garment on hand. I
spent a
looong time knitting it, and I
think it has the
proper divine air.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yielding to Wonder Acute's emphatic
insistence, I
change into the garment.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it looks good on you. Why, it's as if
Hotei of
the Seven Gods of Luck is
standing before me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now I can offer my prayers from here in
your
office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aside from a light feeling of blasphemy,
I have to
admit... cosplaying as a god is
pretty fun.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! Has the thrill of being
clad in
costume awakened within you as
well?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe somewhere deep down, a bit of
T.M.
Opera O has rubbed off on me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your blessings, O divine
one. By
the way...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Are you able to perform any miraculous
feats?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oooh, how lovely! Very impressive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I lost myself in the moment. But now
that I've
made that claim, I have to
follow through.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So what are you going to conjure for
me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
New Year's gifts...
After a quick think, I
go with...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a meat bun! And it's still piping
hot.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch... It's very good, thank you. I can feel it warming me up from my belly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks so happy eating it, it gives me
an idea.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, would I! To be honest, I prefer red
bean buns
when given a choice.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But do you have any?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This mighty New Year's deity has the
power to
acquire steamed buns of all
varieties with just a
visit to the local
convenience store.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, look at all these red bean
buns! Thank
you so much, dearie!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Why, you're starting to look genuinely
divine to
these eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Wonder Acute's stomach is
satisfied.
Sure, the convenience store
clerk may have
laughed at me because
of my getup, but the look
on her face
makes it all worth it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, so this is a lucky wand?! Deities
certainly
carry around the most
interesting things.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And I know someone who would love
this. In fact,
I think I'll invite her over to
join us.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So, Rickey dear. Is this the "feng shui"
power
you're always talking about?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Pew pew pew! Time, be frozen!
Kagami
mochi, shatter!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Kinako flour, stay put! Be still, even if I
sneeze!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! That's not what I mean by
feng shui
power...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: But it does look like fun! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears she has the wrong idea about
what
feng shui can do...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But Wonder Acute doesn't sweat the
details. She
continues to wave the wand
and enjoy the feeling
of being
all-powerful.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a planner! I can fill this with all the
goals I
want to achieve this year.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Plotting out my training
schedule is
sure to help me improve.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll need to write in the dates of my
races, and...
what else?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I think I'm out of soy sauce. So soy
sauce,
and some sliced ham, and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's even writing out a grocery list. By
noting
everything down, I'm sure she'll
remember the
important stuff.
